fields.description: The question the rep is asked. A section or tab break uses it as the heading instead.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The key this answer is stored under, and the name a rule points at.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: The kind of input the rep is given. Tab, Section and Column breaks are layout rather than questions.

fields.description: For a dropdown, one option per line. For a lookup, the record type it points at.
fields.label: Options

fields.description: Mandatory on every save. A question required only under a condition is declared under Rules instead.
fields.label: Required

fields.description: Optional condition under which this question is shown. Leave blank where a rule already controls it.
fields.label: Depends On

fields.description: Filled in from the rules. It is the condition under which this question is required.
fields.label: Mandatory Depends On

fields.description: The owner of this information. Activity is answered by the rep; Lead is read from the patient record and kept as it stood that day.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Show the answer but do not let the rep change it. On a Lead field this also stops the punch writing back to the patient record.
fields.label: Read Only

fields.description: The place the answer is stored. Blank stores it in the general answers store.
fields.label: Section

fields.description: The column the answer occupies. Blank stores it under its own name.
fields.label: Target
